title: The Broken Compass
author: B. M. Nakamura
blurb: Lena Halloran, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when an old rival hires the crew for the one job that was sworn off long ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
